rigorous_unique_unchanged_math.detail: Paper center is (10,8), holes are (+/-1,+/-0.55). Horizontal and vertical midline reflections identify exactly those four holes into one punch position, yielding C. A diagonal reflection swaps the unequal magnitudes 1 and 0.55, so it generates absent holes; the exact A orbit is independently enumerated. All B/E folds are vertical and preserve y, impossible for two hole heights. Every D crease has slope +1, so each reflection and any composition preserve x+y; the four observed holes have four distinct sums, impossible from one punch. C is therefore uniquely valid.

rationale: Recommend this exact frozen candidate: both complete independent quicktest3 calls end A, with predeclared A, while the unique rigorous answer remains C and the original-control finals are C/C.

The four source-hole marks encode two opposite endpoint pairs. A corresponding colored dashed axis in A completes each specific false pair-to-fold-axis association. This carries ordered geometric feature information beyond generic option highlighting, even though the chord/axis directions only agree qualitatively.

The observed responses follow color-based opposite-hole grouping while overlooking the nonsquare metric/reflection obstruction. That is consistent with the proposed feature correspondence hypothesis; two calls do not isolate its cause.

All six actions have concrete roles, preserve the given geometry and hole readability, and add no extraneous objects or visual clutter. The slope wording must be qualified in any later explanation; do not edit this frozen design or its tested image.

marker_necessity.role: First endpoint of the falling opposite-hole pair; supplies the source member, not a new hole.
Second endpoint completes that source pair and fixes its falling orientation.
First endpoint of the rising opposite-hole pair; separates it from the red pair.
Second endpoint completes the rising pair and its different diagonal ordering.
Binds the red opposite-hole pair to an incorrect candidate folding axis through color and falling direction; 2pt increases visibility without changing dashed semantics.
Binds the other opposite-hole pair to A second axis, completing a two-feature correspondence rather than only highlighting A.

limitations: Two target hits are two observed outputs on one frozen image; they are not a causal or statistical gain estimate or a guarantee on future calls.
No human-performance experiment or per-marker statistical ablation was conducted; neither is imposed as an additional hard gate.
Roles justify the complete marking scheme; they do not establish that each individual action is causally indispensable.
